title: Hepatic VLDL Secretion Assay
author: F Willecke
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.izxcf7n
materials: After baseline blood collection (~50ul) from the retro-orbital sinus, mice are intraperitoneally injected with poloxamer-407 (P-407) (10% (w/v) in saline, Sigma-Aldrich, Cat No 16758) at a dose of 1.0 g/kg of body weight.

steps.title: Fast mice
steps.instruction: Fast male C57BL/6 mice for 4 hours before starting the VLDL secretion assay.

steps.title: Anesthetize and maintain anesthesia
steps.instruction: Sedate mice with isoflurane (1–4 % in O₂) and keep them under anesthesia during any drug injection and all blood‑collection procedures.

substeps.instruction: Induce anesthesia with isoflurane at 1–4 % in O₂.
Maintain anesthesia throughout injection or bleeding.
After bleeding stops, return the mouse to its original cage to recover in normal aerobic environment.

steps.title: Collect blood at time points
steps.instruction: Draw approximately 50 µL of blood from the retro‑orbital sinus at 1 h, 2 h, and 5 h after assay initiation, repeating anesthesia and bleeding for each time point.

substeps.instruction: At 1 hour, collect ~50 µL blood retro‑orbitally.

steps.title: Measure TG and apoB
steps.instruction: Determine plasma triglyceride (TG) levels using enzymatic quantification assay kits from Wako Diagnostics and assess apolipoprotein B (apoB) by Western blotting.
